products.name: Entra External Identities (B2B) & Cross-Tenant Access — Commercial
products.short_description: Collaborate securely with partners — Entra B2B external identities, cross-tenant access settings, and governed guest lifecycle.
products.description:
Collaborate securely with partners — Entra B2B external identities, cross-tenant access settings, and governed guest lifecycle.

Ungoverned guest sprawl and open external collaboration are a data-exfiltration surface. This solution stands up Entra External Identities properly: cross-tenant access settings (inbound/outbound trust, B2B collaboration and direct connect), guest invitation and self-service controls, Conditional Access for guests, and an access-review-driven guest lifecycle so external access is deliberate, scoped, and time-bound.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Cross-tenant access settings — B2B collaboration, direct connect, trust settings
  • Guest invitation, self-service sign-up, and entitlement-managed access
  • Conditional Access policies scoped to external users
  • Guest lifecycle — access reviews, expiration, and cleanup
  • Cross-tenant sync (where used) and monitoring

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Governed external collaboration — partners onboarded through deliberate, scoped, time-bound access instead of unmanaged guest sprawl.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTB2B-CleanupStaleGuests.ps1 — safely disable (then remove) stale guest accounts (default -WhatIf)
    • ENTB2B-Discovery.ps1 — External Identities posture: cross-tenant access settings, guests, guest CA, access packages
    • ENTB2B-Report.ps1 — guest-lifecycle report: guests by last sign-in, never-signed-in, and inactive
    • ENTB2B-Set-CrossTenantAccess.ps1 — safely configure per-partner cross-tenant access + trust (default -WhatIf)
    • ENTB2B-Validate.ps1 — validate the B2B pilot: conservative defaults, trusted partner, guest CA, break-glass exclusion

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
